DARSHANIM.Sync.Interdit: DAS · Animations: enable the BLFX setting "BLFX Custom Auto-Rec Updates" (Boss Loot module settings), then reload. It lets this module add its animations to the Custom Auto-Rec; your own entries are kept.
DARSHANIM.Sync.Problemes: DAS · Animations: {n} animation(s) could not be sent to BLFX — see the console for details.
DARSHANIM.Sync.Echec: DAS · Animations: BLFX did not confirm the Custom Auto-Rec import — see the console for details.
DARSHANIM.Settings.Renderer.Name: Effect renderer
DARSHANIM.Settings.Renderer.Hint: How the effects this module plays itself are shown — potions and consumables (a potion drunk or administered, a poison applied, a flask thrown, a scroll read, food and drink), traps, spell walls and the spell areas nothing else animates. Auto: Boss Loot (BLFX), otherwise JB2A (free or Patreon) with PSFX sounds, otherwise Token Magic FX, otherwise a built-in coloured ring (green: beneficial, red: harmful, blue: neutral). A renderer that is not installed falls back to the next one. Whatever Automated Animations already plays is left to it.
DARSHANIM.Settings.Renderer.Auto: Auto (BLFX, then JB2A + PSFX, then Token Magic FX, then built-in)
DARSHANIM.Settings.AaNames.Name: Automated Animations in every language
DARSHANIM.Settings.AaNames.Hint: Automated Animations recognises items by their English name. When it finds nothing with the translated name, give it the matching entry from the item's English name (Babele), its dnd5e identifier, its base weapon, or the translation table of the world's language (French included). Replaces the "Automated Animation for Babele" module. Your own entries in another language still win.
DARSHANIM.Settings.AaYield.Name: Automated Animations: customised only, gives way to BLFX
DARSHANIM.Settings.AaYield.Hint: Automated Animations is optional: only the animations you customised in it (on an item, or an entry you added or edited in its Auto-Rec) still play, before this module; its built-in entries stay silent whenever this module or Boss Loot (BLFX) animates the item. When BLFX is also active, your customised animations give way to BLFX for the items BLFX animates (BLFX cannot be silenced item by item), so nothing plays twice. Its critical-hit animation is not covered (turn it off in its own settings if needed).
DARSHANIM.Settings.Strikes.Name: Attack, spell and healing animations
DARSHANIM.Settings.Strikes.Hint: Weapon attacks (melee, ranged, thrown, natural attacks), targeted spells (attack roll or saving throw) and healing are animated by this module with JB2A (free or Premium) and PSFX sounds: a swing, a projectile or a spell effect toward each target, a miss that goes past it, a bigger impact on a critical hit, a lighter one on a successful save. With DAS · Core the animation follows its verdict (after Shield, after the saves). Area spells are left to their area. Whatever Boss Loot (BLFX) or Automated Animations already animates is left to them. Automated Animations is not needed.
DARSHANIM.Settings.Conditions.Name: Condition animations
DARSHANIM.Settings.Conditions.Hint: While a creature is Frightened, Charmed, Poisoned, Stunned, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Restrained, Grappled, Blinded, Deafened, Silenced, Petrified or Cursed, a JB2A loop plays on its token and stops when the condition ends. Placed by the active GM, seen by everyone (subject to vision).
DARSHANIM.Settings.ConditionsWithBlfx.Hi: Boss Loot (BLFX) plays its own loop for most of these conditions when one of its spells applies them. Off: those conditions are left to BLFX. On: this module plays them too (they may then show twice).
DARSHANIM.Sources.Title: Animation sources
DARSHANIM.Sources.Menu.Name: Animation sources
DARSHANIM.Sources.Menu.Label: Choose sources
DARSHANIM.Sources.Menu.Hint: What is installed (BLFX, JB2A, PSFX, Token Magic FX, Automated Animations), the order DAS · Animations uses them in, and the source of each domain: attacks, conditions, consumables, traps, walls, areas, doors, summons.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Intro: For each domain, the first source in the list that is installed, ticked and able to do it is used. Nothing is saved until “Save”.
DARSHANIM.Sources.OrderHint: Drag a row, or use the arrows. An unticked source is no longer used by DAS · Animations.
DARSHANIM.Sources.DomainsHint: The source that will play with what is installed. Untick a domain so DAS · Animations plays nothing there.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Role.blfx: Plays by itself whatever its Auto-Rec recognises, even unticked: nothing can stop it item by item. Its place decides whether DAS · Animations also plays those items; the box sets what DAS · Animations asks of it (consumables, traps, walls, doors, smites).
DARSHANIM.Sources.Role.aa: Only the animations you customised in Automated Animations; its shipped animations always give way to DAS · Animations. Placed after a source, it gives way to it; unticked, it gives way everywhere.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Role.jb2a: DAS · Animations' own rendering: attacks, spells, heals, conditions and the rest. JB2A Premium is preferred over the free one; without PSFX, no sound.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Role.tokenmagic: Filters on tokens and areas: consumables, traps, spell areas.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Role.native: A coloured ring on the token: consumables and traps, as a last resort.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Notes.NoSequencer: Sequencer is not active: BLFX, JB2A and PSFX cannot play anything without it.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Notes.BothJb2a: Free JB2A and JB2A Premium are both active: Premium is enough, the free one can be disabled.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Notes.NoPsfx: PSFX is not active: JB2A animations will play without sound.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Notes.BlfxUpdates: The BLFX setting “BLFX Custom Auto-Rec Updates” is not ticked: the DAS · Animations table is not added to the BLFX Auto-Rec.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Notes.BlfxAutoRecOff: The BLFX Auto-Rec is off: BLFX plays nothing by itself.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Notes.OnlyNative: No BLFX, JB2A or Token Magic FX: only the built-in rendering plays (consumables and traps).
DARSHANIM.Sources.Notes.InstalledOff: {id} is installed but not enabled in this world.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Table.nothing: No installed and ticked source can do this domain.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Table.blfxAlso: Placed before BLFX: items BLFX recognises are played by both.
DARSHANIM.Sources.Table.aaFirst: A customised Automated Animations animation goes first.
